question: Rati travels from City A to City B. If Rati drives her car at 1/3 of her normal speed, then she reaches City B 50 minutes late. Find the time (in minutes) that Rati would take to travel from City A to City B if she drove at her normal speed.
solution:
**Given:**

Speed at which Rati drives = dfrac{1}{3} of normal speed

Delay = 50 minutes

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

If speed is reduced to 1/3, time becomes 3 times the normal time.

**Calculations:**

Let normal time = x minutes

At 1/3 speed, time taken = 3x

Delay = 3x - x = 2x

⇒ 2x = 50

⇒ x = 25

**∴ The normal time to travel from City A to City B is 25 minutes.**
